column1: # derivation: §7.9: upper and lower are the simple (one-to-one)
# Unicode case mapping per code point; upper(U+00DF) is U+1E9E, not "SS".
# NULL in, NULL out. us = upper(s): 1 "ABC"; 2 U+00E9 to U+00C9, so "H"
# U+00C9 "LLO"; 3 U+65E5 U+672C have no case, unchanged; 4 U+1F600 has no
# bytes to 3); 9 unchanged. ls = lower(s): ASCII capitals fold (row 7's S),
# the rest is unchanged. lt = lower(t): row 7 U+00C4 U+00D6 to U+00E4
# U+00F6; row 9 U+FF21 (fullwidth A) to U+FF41; rows 1, 3, 4, 6 unchanged
